description:
## 1.0.0 (2026-10-04)

* First release. Patches for RailOne (org.cris.aikyam):
  * Disable the native security SDK (stops AikyamApplication loading libnative-lib.so, the root cause of the app force-stopping and wiping its own data on a re-signed build)
  * Bypass USB-debugging detection (adb_enabled, adb_wifi_enabled, development_settings_enabled)
  * Bypass APK signature verification
  * Bypass the rjsniffer adb_enabled check in its isolated process
* Verified on RailOne 2.1.66 (versionCode 237) and 2.1.62, arm64.
